flashcard_questions.q: What was Louis Pasteur's profession before his medical discoveries?
Which incorrect theory claimed that decay and life simply appeared out of nowhere?
What did Pasteur's swan-necked flask experiment prove?
flashcard_questions.a: That microbes in the air cause decay.

flashcard_questions.q: In which year did Pasteur publish his Germ Theory?
Which insects was Pasteur funded to study, proving germs caused their disease?
Which term means the idea that each disease is caused by its own particular germ?
What did Koch use to grow pure cultures of bacteria on a solid surface?
Why did Koch stain bacteria with industrial dyes?
flashcard_questions.a: To make them visible under a microscope.

flashcard_questions.q: Which animal did Koch inject with anthrax to prove bacteria cause disease?
In which year did Koch identify the anthrax bacterium?
Koch identified the bacterium that causes tuberculosis in ____.
Whose 1854 findings about cholera did Koch's 1883 discovery confirm?
How many disease-causing bacteria did Koch's team identify?
Which surgeon was inspired by Germ Theory to develop antiseptic surgery in 1867?
Which of Koch's students developed drugs known as 'magic bullets'?

notes: 15 cards: 4 term-to-definition, 4 discovery-to-date (one cloze), 4 method or proof, 3 person. Only two bare 'In which year' fronts kept, so the date cards do not interfere.
